walkthroughs.body_html:
The Sociology of Education — a core area of GCSE Sociology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

The Sociology of Education brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Sociology of Education.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between reliability and validity in research?
options: Reliability is whether a method produces consistent results when repeated; validity is whether it actually measures what it claims to. A method can be reliable but invalid, or valid but unreliable.
Reliable and valid mean the same thing — that the research is good.
